snippet.title: Call of Elyndra Announcement
snippet.description:
Call of Elyndra is an upcoming debut game from Quorum Games. It combines the best of cozy farming games and oldschool 2D action RPGs. Farm, explore and fight!

➡️ A narrative-driven cozy game with plenty of action.
➡️ Focus on farming and socializing or combat and questing… Or do both!
➡️ Beautiful hand-made pixel graphics.
➡️ Around 30 hours of core gameplay.
➡️ Various NPCs and biomes - make friends and explore the world.

Head on over to Steam and wishlist the game!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2902600/Call_of_Elyndra/

Demo is coming to Steam on 2.12.2024

Platform: Steam, possible further ports
Release date: TBA
Genre: RPG, simulator, cozy
Studio: Quorum Games
Engine: heavily modified RPG Maker
Multiplayer: No

—
